intro: Government and technology sectors faced significant incident response challenges between April 13 and May 2, 2026, with 13 articles covering a severity mix of one informational, six high, two critical, and one medium event. The most prominent vulnerability was CVE-2025-59718, carrying a CVSS score of 9.8. Affected regions included Europe, North America, the United States, Venezuela, and Global entities, while impacted sectors spanned government, technology, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and cybersecurity services.
